plotTwists: {user}'s cheer is so loud it accidentally starts a server-wide chant that nobody can stop.
The cheer is so motivating that {target} immediately starts cheering for {user} back, and it becomes a loop.
A stray cat starts meowing along, completely out of rhythm but fully committed.
The cheer triggers a chain reaction — three random NPCs join in unprompted.
{user} cheers so hard they lose their voice for a second, which somehow makes it funnier.
The Whisper Merchant appears and offers to bottle the hype energy and sell it.
Time loops back and the cheer happens twice, just as loud both times.
